name: search_anime
description: Search for anime by title. Returns title, episode count, status, score, genres, and synopsis. Use get_anime with the ID for full details.

query.description: Anime title to search for, e.g. "Attack on Titan" or "Cowboy Bebop"

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–25, default 10)

name: get_anime
description: Get full anime details by ID. Returns title, synopsis, episodes, duration, status, score, genres, studios, and season information.

id.description: AniList media ID (e.g. 21 for One Piece, 1 for Cowboy Bebop)

name: trending_anime
description: Get currently trending anime ranked by popularity. Returns title, status, score, episode count, and genres. Use get_anime with the ID for full details.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–25, default 10)
